matchInput: I want to open a cafe
aliases: I want to open a coffee shop
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for cafe brand identity
steps.why: A clear logo and visual style help customers recognize your cafe and guide later design work. Establishing brand assets first avoids re‑work when signage or marketing materials are created.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for interior and menu shots
steps.why: High‑quality photos showcase the ambience and food on your website and social channels. Capturing the space early ensures you have assets for launch marketing.

steps.title: Hire a web developer for a simple cafe website
steps.why: A website provides your menu, location, and contact info, and integrates the photos and brand you have created. Launching the site before opening helps customers find you and builds anticipation.

steps.title: Hire a social media marketer to launch and manage your cafe’s online presence
steps.why: Consistent posting on platforms like Facebook and Instagram drives foot traffic and keeps your audience engaged. Starting social campaigns alongside the website maximizes reach at opening.

steps.title: Engage a company‑registration specialist (or accountant) for legal setup
steps.why: Proper registration and bookkeeping are required to operate legally and manage finances. Securing this expertise early prevents compliance issues later.
